name: Booked In
maturity: Built and tested, not yet provisioned (no live email or payments)

brand.tone: Warm, plain-spoken and candid, written in British English for working beauty professionals rather than technologists, and careful never to oversell.

facts.text: Booked In is a booking page built for solo beauty professionals.

source.quote: **A booking page for solo beauty professionals.**

facts.text: Her clients book themselves from a link in her Instagram bio.

source.quote: Her clients book themselves, from a link in her Instagram bio.

facts.text: It is made for people running a beauty business on their own.

source.quote: and what it does for someone running a beauty business on her own.

facts.text: Lash technicians who currently manage their diary through Instagram DMs are a core audience.

source.quote: A lash technician's diary lives in her Instagram DMs.

facts.text: It serves both technicians who travel to clients and those who work from home, a rented chair or a shop.

source.quote: The other half works from a room at home, a chair rented in a salon, or a shop

facts.text: Booking by DM means late-night availability questions, and by the time she replies the client has often gone quiet and the slot stays empty.

source.quote: By the time she answers, the client has gone quiet and the slot is still empty.

facts.text: Marketplace booking sites show her client other technicians nearby; Booked In keeps the page hers alone.

source.quote: her photographs, her prices, her link, and no marketplace

facts.text: Most booking platforms leave patch-test compliance to the technician, even though a missing dated record can put her insurance cover at risk.

source.quote: **Every booking platform treats this as her problem.**

facts.text: The rebooking reminder a studio means to send often never gets sent.

source.quote: it is simply the message a studio means to send and never does.

facts.text: There is no commission, no marketplace, and nobody else is advertised on her page.

source.quote: No commission, no marketplace, and nobody else advertised on her page.
